patterns.message: shared/ holds business-agnostic primitives and imports nothing else from src/. See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
config/ only defines typed configuration; it must not depend on app/, modules/ or infrastructure/. See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
infrastructure/ provides technical adapters and must not import app/ or modules/. See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Read typed values from config/*.config.ts; only config/ reads the raw Env. See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
modules/ must not import the composition root (app/). See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Import another module through its public index.ts (e.g. '../users'), never its internal files. See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Import infrastructure through its folder index (e.g. '../../infrastructure/database'). See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Read typed values from config/*.config.ts; only config/ reads the raw Env. See apps/api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
